messages:
Sasha: FYI canary shows dashboard LCP jump ~1.7s (baseline ~0.42s). heatmap + sparkline blocking main thread.
Rahul: traces show big parse/compile when charts mount; culprit chunk seems to be 'viz-core'.
Taylor: bundle-ci diff: viz-core@2.1.0 +410KB gz vs 2.0.3. looks like a hoisted import pulled intl/px2rem into the main chunk.
Sasha: deploy-bot rolled canary 1820 earlier with a routing tweak favoring eu-region for chart routes. was viz-core bump intentional?
Rahul: rollout API shows viz-core@2.1.0 at 15% for charts-render feature.
Joel: I thought the bump was for a small QA bucket only, not general canary.
Taylor: webpack splitpoint moved; dynamic tile import got inlined into viz-core, so heatmap renderer no longer lazy.
Maria: also saw instrumentation flipped to 'full' traces in PR #4972. now every chart mount serializes a big trace; doubles CPU and network work.
Sasha: ugh. reviewer missed instrumentLevel change?
Rahul: yes, instrumentLevel went from 'marks'->'full'.
Taylor: mitigation suggestions:
- pin viz-core to 2.0.3 in canary
- revert instrumentation to 'marks'
- reintroduce dynamic import in tile-render to restore splitpoint
- temporarily lower telemetry sampling for sparklines on canary
Maria: I've applied sampling.sparklines=0.02 for the charts-render feature on canary.
Joel: agree pin first. Rahul can you post the rollout pin curl?
Rahul: POST /internal/rollouts {"feature":"charts-render","modules":[{"name":"viz-core","ver":"2.0.3"}],"percent":15} (use admin token)
Sasha: rolling back now and opening hotfix PR to re-add dynamic import and add bundle diff check in CI.
deploy-bot: rollback started for canary 1820 by Sasha at 2025-12-03T11:04:12Z
Taylor: CI note: ensure splitpoint id matches our route prefetch heuristics or prefetcher will pull chunk back in.
Maria: proposing a release guard: block auto-rollout if any module grows >150KB gz vs previous. added instrumentation checklist to PR template.
Joel: verification plan:
1) monitor LCP and main-thread parse (expect drop to ~0.45s)
2) tail browser-trace logs
3) run local bundle-diff viz-core 2.1.0 vs 2.0.3
Rahul: rollback applied, early signals show parse durations back to baseline on canary.
Sasha: keeping canary at reduced traffic until hotfix merges. thanks team :thumbsup:
Taylor: filing post-incident note + timeline; will add follow-ups to CI checks and prefetch heuristics.
